Subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoZanix patient with sudden difficulty breathing and facial swelling

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Fictional Community Clinic (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 34-year-old male patient with a history of generalized anxiety disorder received their second dose of DemoZanix (dose: 50mg) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-05-18.
Approximately 4 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed sudden difficulty breathing and facial swelling.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
J. Tanaka (fictional reporter)
Fictional Community Clinic
Contact: demo.reporter744@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
